newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Xpress to acquire truckload carrier.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Xpress to acquire truckload carrier.

text.p: U.S. Xpress Enterprises Inc on Friday said it has reached an agreement to acquire all of the outstanding stock of privately held JTI Inc and its related affiliates.
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed. The acquisition is expected to be completed by April 30.
JTI is a non-union truckload carrier based in Lincoln, Nebraska, with annual revenues of about $25 million.
JTI Inc will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Xpress Enterprises. JTI management will continue to lead the company, headed by David Parker, chairman, and Alan Hingst, president.
